title: Corso's claims of a covert Roswell group and reverse-engineered technology
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Corso's claims of a covert Roswell group and reverse-engineered technology, about 1947-1960s at Roswell, New Mexico, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: in his book The Day After Roswell Corso claims a covert government group was assembled under the leadership of Admiral Roscoe hilenquitter

stuff comes down and then you know gets collected it gets taken to Rosco Hiller who's the first director of the CIA and then uh Philip J Corso who is the um you know chief of the army's foreign technology exploitation desk. He is given the material and that material is systematically doled out to the private sector namely Bell Labs.
tellings.difference: Names Bell Labs as the private-sector recipient and gives Corso's role as chief of the Army's foreign technology desk.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell Corso's account: Roswell material went to Hillenkoetter and then to Corso, who passed it on for reverse engineering.

as_told.title: Corso: Roswell material doled out to Bell Labs

tellings.quote: He says that as part of that role, basically crash materials from Roswell were given to him to dole out to private industry and mainly it was given to Bell Labs.
tellings.difference: Leaves out the Hillenkoetter-led covert group and puts the focus on Corso's role in giving the material to Bell Labs.
tellings.link_reason: In both, Corso says in The Day After Roswell that he received Roswell crash material and handed it out to private industry, mainly Bell Labs.

as_told.title: Corso gives Roswell materials to Bell Labs

tellings.quote: about Roswell, like the material ends up in foreign material exploitation at, you know, Wright Patterson, at least according to the Philip J. Corso account
tellings.difference: Puts the material in foreign material exploitation at Wright-Patterson rather than being handed out to Bell Labs, and also credits Neil McCasland.
tellings.link_reason: Corso's account of what happened to the Roswell crash material after it was recovered, the same account as the Corso reverse-engineering story.

as_told.title: Roswell material sent to foreign material exploitation at Wright-Patterson

tellings.quote: that's exactly when uh Colonel Philip J Corso of the armies not air forces foreign technology division says that technologies were being seated into basically US defense contractors
tellings.difference: Dates the seeding to 1959-1960 and speaks of US defense contractors in general rather than naming Bell Labs.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell Corso's claim that, from his Army foreign technology post, recovered alien technology was handed out to private industry and defense contractors.

as_told.title: Corso: technologies seeded into defense contractors

tellings.quote: Philip Corso saying that he helped dole out a lot of this material and it made it into the civil sector because of his position.
tellings.difference: Says 'civil sector' generally without naming Bell Labs or Roswell, and puts it at the Pentagon in the 1960s.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell Corso's claim that recovered crash material passed through him and was doled out to the private/civil sector.

as_told.title: Philip Corso doled out recovered material to civil sector
